typography.rules: Never center align massive numbers; offset them asymmetrically. Giant numbers must have tighter tracking and compressed line heights. Data context must use monospaced precision fonts.

colors.background_strategy: Avoid pure black. Use monumental architectural tones. Light theme: 'bg-[#EAE8E3]' (warm concrete). Dark theme: 'bg-[#18181A]' (deep charcoal, not black).
colors.text_strategy: Primary numbers use the persistent Team Theme color (Ferrari Red #E32636, Mercedes Teal #00A19B, McLaren Papaya #FF8000) or high-contrast structural grayscale (e.g., #111111).
colors.accents: Subtle border colors 'border-black/10' or 'border-white/10' for spatial nodes and kinetic lines.

layouts.container: Single 100svh page (h-[100svh] w-screen overflow-hidden). NO internal vertical scrolling. Everything exists in a spatial, layered z-index configuration.
layouts.composition: Reject grid/cards. Use 'Kinetic Data Sculpture'. Records are absolutely positioned blocks overlapping and interacting with background circuit geometry.
layouts.controls_position: Bottom-left or bottom-center fixed constellation node controller for category switching.
layouts.safe_zones: Top-left for 'Back to CH.05 / Circuit' routing, Top-right for potential global controls.

Championships.title: Years Span
Championships.context: Longest time between first & last title (2008-2020)

Wins.context: Most wins with the same team

Pole Positions.context: Most pole positions at the same circuit

motion.libraries: Framer Motion (for spatial transitions and layout shifts)
motion.category_switch: When switching categories via constellation nodes, the current kinetic sculpture scales down/fades out (-y or z-axis push), and the new category's numbers slam/slide into view with a stagger-children effect.
motion.number_animation: Giant primary numbers should use a counter animation (0 to value) over 1.5s on initial mount, utilizing 'framer-motion' useSpring for weight.
motion.reduced_motion: Wrap massive spatial animations in a 'useReducedMotion' check to default to opacity fades for accessibility.

interactions.category_controller: Spatial Constellation Nodes. A connected SVG node map or pill-segmented control where clicking a point shifts the 'camera' (data view).
interactions.keyboard: Arrow keys (Left/Right) or Tab must switch between record categories.
interactions.routing: Include a prominent 'Back to Circuit / CH.05' button (Top Left) to maintain native Gallery->Records->Milestones journey.

visual enhancers.circuit_geometry: Background contains subtle, slow-rotating SVG circuit geometries or thin architectural grids to give the spatial void scale.
visual enhancers.texture: Overlay a fixed mix-blend-overlay noise texture (opacity 0.05) to avoid flat digital colors and reinforce the monumental/concrete aesthetic.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure data context and small texts meet 4.5:1 ratio against the monumental backgrounds.
accessibility.test_ids: Crucial: Add 'data-testid' to ALL navigation nodes (e.g., 'data-testid="nav-node-wins"'), the main numbers ('data-testid="primary-record-value"'), and the back button ('data-testid="back-to-circuit-button"').

trophy_visuals.description: Optional background imagery to support the monumental feel if typography isn't enough.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. NEVER USE CARDS or GRIDS for this page. It is a typographic monument. 2. Ensure responsive scaling: use viewport units (vw/vh/svh) and 'clamp()' for typography to handle 1920x800 down to 320x700 flawlessly. 3. Maintain persistent team theme (do not reset state when viewing records). 4. Do NOT use black background, stick to structural grays or theme-adaptive concrete tones. 5. Include unique data-testid attributes for all interactive UI elements.
